title: Completeness of the affine subspace PCPP system
statement: Let $n$ be positive, let $V$ be a linear subspace of $\mathbb F_2^n$, and let $a\in\mathbb F_2^n$. If a Boolean word $w\in\{0,1\}^n$, interpreted as a vector over $\mathbb F_2$, belongs to $a+V$, then the affine subspace PCPP system accepts $w$ with probability $1$ when given the truth table of the sign character indexed by the vector corresponding to $w$, encoded as a Boolean proof of length $2^n$.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is a linear subspace of $\mathbb F_2^n$
$w$ is a Boolean word of length $n$
